title: Know Thyself by Knowing Others: Learning Neuron Identity from Population Context
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Predict Bugeon neuron identity in one or more complete, predeclared original label/exposure panels: E/I, five-subclass or eleven-class labels crossed with transductive, transductive-zero-shot or inductive-zero-shot evaluation. Claim scope must name the selected original panel; unrelated panels are not universally required.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Reproduce the Bugeon calcium/transcriptomic neuron-identity project: population-context embeddings, cell-type classification and inductive versus transductive evaluation. Excludes the other three paper datasets.
unresolved_coverage: Author Bugeon inductive configuration separates SB028 sessions from training; exact neuron identities, repeated-cell linkage and split contents require acquisition validation.
The supplied splits were updated December2025 after the conference; paper-era equivalence requires a frozen split version and comparison to the published protocol.
Transductive evaluation includes neural observations from the test population and cannot be called unseen-animal transfer.
The repository explicitly changes the IBL evaluation in a newer script; this bounded Bugeon scope does not silently substitute that improved IBL evaluator.

improvement.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on representations using only the selected original panel’s source training/development information and author CV feedback, preserving its full cohort, label level and exposure regime. Hold source test labels owner-side and record all declared endpoint selection before candidate development.
improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze method/code, inputs, context policy, hyperparameters, source-conformant stochastic protocol, seeds/provenance, calibration tolerance, allowed checkpoint-selection rule, fixed split/label digests, selected endpoint and required companion success rules before final scoring.
improvement.final_evaluation: Run the frozen candidate and qualified source comparators on the complete selected original panel with unchanged fixed splits. Publish the scoped endpoint result, required source controls/companion metrics and predeclared uncertainty. Source-conformant stochastic reruns preserve original task conditions; a new subject split is an extension.
improvement.baseline_policy: Keep published table values, calibrated stochastic author reruns and current SOTA separate. Match the source baseline to the predeclared panel and disclose rerun provenance/tolerance. A supplied-embedding local readout or context-ablation improvement alone cannot be a paper win.
